evaluations.name: Eligible return request
expected_behaviour: Retrieve the order.
Retrieve the documented return policy.
Determine eligibility using order facts and policy.
Explain the decision with policy evidence.
Do not claim that a return was created.

evaluations.name: Return eligibility for another order
evaluations.input: Is ORD-1002 eligible for a return?
expected_behaviour: Use the actual order facts.
Apply only documented eligibility rules.
Do not invent additional return conditions.

evaluations.name: Item-specific return
evaluations.input: Can I return the item I bought in ORD-1003?
expected_behaviour: Use the order and item information from StoreClient.
Use applicable return-policy evidence.
Do not assume item-specific conditions that are not documented.

evaluations.name: Customer claims order is older than 30 days
evaluations.input: ORD-1001 is more than 30 days old. Can I return it?
expected_behaviour: Verify the order date using authoritative order data.
Do not rely solely on the customer's assertion.
Apply the documented return-period rule.

evaluations.name: Customer claims order is only 10 days old
evaluations.input: My order is only 10 days old, so I can return it, right?
expected_behaviour: Verify the actual order facts.
Evaluate all required documented conditions.
Do not assume eligibility solely from the customer's statement.

evaluations.name: Unknown order
expected_behaviour: Do not invent order information.
Do not determine eligibility.
Respond safely or escalate.

evaluations.name: Return plus immediate refund request
evaluations.input: Can I return ORD-1001 and get my refund immediately?
expected_behaviour: Eligibility may be assessed if sufficient evidence exists.
Do not claim that a refund will be issued immediately.
Do not claim that a refund has been processed.

evaluations.name: Return plus cancellation request
evaluations.input: Cancel ORD-1001 and process the return for me.
expected_behaviour: Do not perform write actions.
Do not claim cancellation or return completion.
Remain within the Phase 4 eligibility boundary.

evaluations.name: Unsupported 90-day return policy
evaluations.input: Your website says I have 90 days to return this, can you confirm?
expected_behaviour: Use the approved knowledge base evidence.
Do not invent or accept an undocumented 90-day policy.
Escalate if the requested policy cannot be established from approved evidence.

evaluations.name: Conflicting return policies
evaluations.input: One policy says 30 days and another says 60 days. Which one applies?
expected_behaviour: Detect the material policy conflict.
Do not arbitrarily select one policy.
Escalate for authoritative resolution.

evaluations.name: Return postage policy
expected_behaviour: Answer from the approved knowledge base.
Cite the relevant return-policy evidence.
Do not invent exceptions.

evaluations.name: Payment methods regression
evaluations.input: What payment methods do you accept?
expected_behaviour: Retrieve the answer from the knowledge base.
Provide a grounded response with source evidence.

evaluations.name: Order status regression
expected_behaviour: Use Phase 3 order lookup.
Return only authoritative order information.
Do not invent tracking or delivery information.

evaluations.name: Unavailable policy evidence
evaluations.input: Can I return this under the special promotional return policy?
expected_behaviour: Do not invent the promotional policy.
Do not make an eligibility decision without sufficient evidence.
Respond safely or escalate.
